meta_description: Q Painting Southampton. Interior and exterior decorating, from feature walls to full house renovation. Free quotes, local team. Call 07702 491725.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to show-stopping interiors. We transform homes across Southampton with meticulous prep and premium finishes.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or your entire home redecorated, we handle interior walls, exterior cladding, feature finishes, and specialist coatings.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Expert prep and application on walls, ceilings, and woodwork. We use premium emulsions and paints that last, with colour advice to suit your space.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Tough, weather-resistant finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls. Protects your home and keeps it looking fresh for years.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold accent walls, textured finishes, or contemporary colour schemes. We bring interior design ideas to life.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Precise hanging of modern or traditional wallpapers, plus careful removal of old coverings. We prepare surfaces properly for flawless results.

services.title: Furniture Painting & Upcycling
services.desc: Transform tired furniture with professional painting and specialist finishes. Ideal for bespoke colours and vintage renovation projects.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Thorough filling, sanding, and priming is the foundation of quality work. We invest time in prep so your finish is immaculate and durable.

about_pullquote: Every job's done as though we're painting our own home.
about_para_1: Q Painting was established over 12 years ago on a simple principle: get the prep right, use quality materials, and treat every home with care. We've built a loyal customer base right across Southampton through honest pricing and meticulous attention to detail. From first-time home buyers touching up a rental to families redecorating their forever homes, we've seen it all — and we've done it right.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen. We turn up on time, we protect your furniture and floors, we leave sites clean, and we stand by our work. We're not the cheapest — but you won't find cowboys cutting corners or disappearing mid-project. That's why word-of-mouth referrals and repeat bookings make up the bulk of our work.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Q Painting

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant from start to finish. The lads turned up on time, moved all our furniture carefully, and the preparation work was so thorough. The finish on the walls is perfect — no drips, no mess. They even cleaned up the skirting boards without being asked. Highly recommend and will definitely book again.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: Had Q Painting decorate our entire downstairs after the kitchen refit. They matched existing paint perfectly, hung new wallpaper in the hallway like professionals, and gave us a fixed price upfront with no hidden costs. They worked around our routines brilliantly. Best decision we made. Top lads.
reviews.author: Susan P.

reviews.text: We were in a nightmare. Our house looked tired and we didn't know where to start. Came out, gave us honest advice on colours and what needed doing, and quoted a fair price. Finished exactly when they said they would. The transformation is incredible. Really happy, can't fault them.
reviews.author: David L.
